title: A per-session compaction window must not dirty settings.json; the handoff hook must read the window in use
why: shiv, Oct 28 15:20 CDT (via the coordinator): running /autocompact on a session to a value other than 500k writes it into his user settings, which on his machine is the repo's tracked settings.json, leaving a stray line change.
note: Two defects. (1) When shiv runs /autocompact with a value other than 500000, Claude Code writes it into his user settings, which on his machine is the repo's tracked settings.json (autoCompactWindow), so the file shows a stray change. A per-session window must not dirty the tracked file. (2) hooks/precompact_handoff.py read only the top-level autoCompactWindow, so it missed a per-session or per-model value. Partly done: half (2), the hook reading the window in use, shipped in #804 (batch 20, main f7e64677, Oct 29 16:48 CDT). Left: half (1) and the per-tier numbers, which wait on item 61. shiv wants per-tier limits (coordinator 1M on Opus, lanes about 400k, a builder at most 300k) and says local sessions need testing. Measured: the variable raises the window (1000000 gives 980000; Oct 28, CC 2.1.312). An agent file's autoCompactWindow works live (Oct 30, CC 2.1.314, cloud): 300000 compacted at 239k and 246k, 100000 at 61-75k, no setting none through 311k. The env sets CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=80; its formula is unmeasured. Item 61 ruled b, Oct 30 12:45 CDT (check first, then set numbers); cloud half done, lane archived. Left before numbers go in: the local launch check (needs shiv's Remote Control folder; coordinator asks in chat), the default compact point, the percent formula. Port: yes, any repo whose user settings are tracked. Placed after c202 (triage 12, Oct 28). Status set back from done Oct 29 19:06 CDT (coordinator, lane fb-task-homes).
